card.name: Small words in geography descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as the, in, or Middle inside place descriptions of rivers, valleys, regions and countries. Mostly in encyclopedia-style text, right before a place name or direction.

modes.label: The before places
modes.description: The word the right before a river, region or geographic feature.

modes.description: Words like Middle or southern that lead into a place name or area.

modes.label: Odd word pieces
modes.description: Scattered word pieces inside a name or term, with no geographic link.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are a mix of unrelated words in several languages.
